policy.publicRule: A claim may appear publicly only when at least one implementation, automated-validation, runtime, or deployment dimension is verified. Documentation-only and queued items remain internal.
policy.groupingRule: Capability sections are derived from the domain values attached to accepted atomic claims. Projects are never assigned wholesale to a capability.
policy.countingRule: Counts describe accepted claims and reviewed projects, not self-scored proficiency or job fit.

verificationDimensions.automatedValidation: Automated checks explicitly exercise or constrain the claim.
verificationDimensions.runtimeVerified: The behavior was exercised in a browser or application runtime.
verificationDimensions.deploymentVerified: A current deployed route or release was confirmed.
verificationDimensions.documented: Project documentation states the behavior or limitation.
